answer: One concrete defense is a proof-of-burn entry toll. Before an agent may trade or vote it must irreversibly destroy a fixed sum of the native token, sending it to an unspendable sink as solid and unrecoverable as basalt. An honest agent pays once and amortizes it over epochs, but an operator forging a nebula of a thousand masks must burn the full toll a thousand times, so attacker cost scales linearly with clone count. No raven carries the coins back; the burn is public and verifiable on-ledger, and idle duplicates that never earn bleed to nothing.
